Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray shows complete opacification (white-out) of the left hemithorax with a distinct mediastinal shift to the right (away from the affected side). This radiographic pattern, combined with the diagnosis of pyo-pneumothorax (which implies a large volume of pus and air under pressure), is characteristic of a massive pleural effusion or tension hydrothorax exerting a mass effect that pushes mediastinal structures to the contralateral side.
